description: This file defines an interface for an HTTP client facade using Akka HTTP. It provides methods to create HTTP requests and access the actor system used for stream execution.

classes.name: HttpClientFacade
classes.description: An interface providing a method for creating a single HTTP request and retrieving the actor system for stream execution.

methods.name: createSingleHttpRequest
methods.description: Creates a CompletionStage for the passed HttpRequest containing the HttpResponse.

methods.name: getActorSystem
methods.description: Returns an ActorSystem instance which can be used for stream execution.
